title: Has a few quirks AND perks!!
text:
Has a few quirks AND perks!!. This handheld/stick vacuum combo is meant to function in both arenas… it can be a handheld “Dustbuster“ style vacuum letting you get into much smaller spaces with ease by holding vac in your hand… Or, attached to an extender- this should function like a regular vacuum for those smaller and lighter needs.

As a handheld vacuum I have no issues. This will fire up and provide a solid suction to clean out a car, countertop, stairs, under furniture cushions, all small hard to reach places. Majority of my need is in this capacity… So I’ve been pleased with his performance.

When attached to the stationary hose “stick“ this loses some of its suction power to pick up items.. Simply bc, items now need to travel 3 feet up the hose under the same suction power… clearly you can see the issue! The floor attachment does not have the expected roller.. which can add to the frustration of being effective- Expecting this to work like a traditional vacuum, it falls a bit short. In this setup I find the small space attachment nozzle is what works best when used with the stick bc it brings the suction force to a smaller opening so, it increases its ability to pick up successfully.

Overall, I find this is best used to vacuum stairs, hard to reach places, countertops and/or inside of a shop.. a cars interior, under cushions of furniture.. Anything else it can take on- I would consider a bonus!! At a price point of $70- you’re paying for a high functioning hand held vacuum. This is best described as a hand held vacuum with bonuses. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe!

Multi-Floor Cleaning: COMFEE’ 20S is easy to maneuver and it picks up dirt and debris with ease. Perfect for hard floors and low pile carpets.
3-in-1 Cleaning: The 20S easily converts into a handvac to effectively clean upholstery, above floor and hard to reach areas.

Multiple accessories included: A crevice tool, dusting brush help clean hard-to-reach areas. Extract dirt, pet hair, freshen up your car, curtains, ceilings or door frames. For your convenience, they are all stored right on the vacuum.
